metric: Exact non-space code-point equality, then missing and extra ASCII-space counts at non-space offsets; mismatches are unscorable failures, never silently discarded.
selection_rule: Retain all original glyph text, identifiers, geometry and extraction indices.
A default change needs human-verified real samples from at least two development PDFs, including both positive and negative spacing boundaries.
Require strictly fewer missing spaces and no extra-space increase versus baseline on each real document, with no unscorable samples or synthetic regressions.
Report agent-checked transcriptions separately; never promote them to human-verified ground truth automatically.
Passing this limited grid does not establish universal spacing or reading-order accuracy.
Leave the held-out manifest and documents unchanged.
